control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 30, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight through a dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follow the line again after it.

branches.outcome: the light is below 30 %: the robot drives forward at 30 %
the light is 30 % or more: it checks the wall
an obstacle is ahead: the robot stops
no obstacle is ahead: it follows the line
black is under the line tracker: it curves left
no black is under the line tracker: it curves right
